title: A merge check of a train is recorded but leaves no mark
what: A merge check of a merge train (a check with review = [] on a branch holding ready changes) recorded with `relay check record check` leaves the "relay: check of <head>" mark the merge hook needs, or the command refuses and says why.
why: 25 Oct, wt/train-2 (eval-close + sonnet-price, both changed bin/relay): the checker recorded open 0 with review = [] and the command printed "recorded … (open 0, queued 0)", but no mark commit appeared; relay check show kept the older mark and "1 non-inert file changed after the mark: bin/relay", and the merge hook refused. The front had to record the combined file as a review finding and run a second check. IP chosen by the front (agent-chosen).
failing_case: In a train worktree whose riders both changed bin/relay, `relay check record check --input` with review = [] and a verdict MET for M1 prints "recorded" and makes no commit.
pass_cases: The same record makes a "relay: check of <head>" commit and relay check show no longer lists bin/relay as changed after the mark; the merge hook accepts the train.
When the input cannot make a mark, the command refuses and names what is missing.
where: .relay/queue/a-merge-check-of-a-train-is-recorded-but-leaves.json relay check record check (lib/relay_verdict.py or bin/relay)
